# Aim

Prepare the reef BCM data for all following scripts:

1. Remove mats with fewer than `min_reads` reads (Methods 2.4).
2. Remove rare ASVs (present in fewer than `prev_threshold` of the mats).
3. Total Sum Scaling (TSS).
4. Stacked table (one row per ASV and mat) with taxonomy and metadata.

Input: `data/bcm_reefs_raja2023.rds` (decontaminated reef BCMs, from 1.Illumina_pipeline.Rmd).

Data products (used by scripts 3–7):

- `data/bcms_filtered_raja2023.rds`: filtered read counts (scripts 3, 6, 7)
- `data/bcms_filtered&tss_reefs_raja2023.rds`: filtered and TSS-normalised (scripts 4, 5)
- `data/ASV_taxa_stacked_tss.csv`: stacked TSS table with taxonomy and metadata (script 4)
- `data/ASV_taxa_table_tss.csv`: TSS table with taxonomy (not used by the scripts; for reference)

Outputs: `figures/2.reads_filtering/F<n>_<name>.pdf` and `outputs/2.reads_filtering/T<n>_<name>.docx` (+ `.csv`).

# Setup

```{r setup, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
packages_used <- c("dplyr", "tidyr", "tibble", "ggplot2", "patchwork",
                   "phyloseq", "flextable", "officer", "beepr")

suppressMessages(invisible(lapply(packages_used, library, character.only = TRUE)))

missing_pkgs <- setdiff(packages_used, .packages())
if (length(missing_pkgs) == 0) message("All packages loaded correctly") else
  message("Packages that did not load: ", paste(missing_pkgs, collapse = ", "))
rm(packages_used, missing_pkgs)

theme_set(theme_bw())
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
set_flextable_defaults(theme_fun = theme_vanilla, font.size = 10, bold_header = TRUE)

fig_dir <- "figures/2.reads_filtering"
tab_dir <- "outputs/2.reads_filtering"
for (d in c(fig_dir, tab_dir)) dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Settings

```{r settings}
input_file    <- "data/bcm_reefs_raja2023.rds"
counts_file   <- "data/bcms_filtered_raja2023.rds"
tss_file      <- "data/bcms_filtered&tss_reefs_raja2023.rds"
stacked_file  <- "data/ASV_taxa_stacked_tss.csv"
tss_table_file <- "data/ASV_taxa_table_tss.csv"

min_reads      <- 10000   # mats with fewer reads are removed (Methods 2.4)
min_count      <- 1       # an ASV is "present" in a mat with at least this many reads
prev_threshold <- 0.10    # ASVs present in fewer than this proportion of mats are removed

tax_ranks <- c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")
```

## Output helpers

```{r output helpers}
# Same helpers as in the other scripts
save_fig <- function(plot, name, width = 11, height = 11) {
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(name, ".pdf")), plot = plot,
         device = cairo_pdf, width = width, height = height, units = "in")
}

save_tab <- function(table, name) {
  doc <- read_docx() %>% body_add_flextable(autofit(flextable(table)))
  print(doc, target = file.path(tab_dir, paste0(name, ".docx")))
  write.csv(table, file.path(tab_dir, paste0(name, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
}

# Same definition of "unassigned" as in scripts 4, 6 and 7
is_unassigned <- function(x) {
  is.na(x) | x == "" |
    grepl("unknown|unidentified|uncultured|unclassified|metagenome", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
}

# Mats, ASVs with reads, reads and reads per mat of a phyloseq object
data_summary <- function(ps, step) {
  tibble(Step = step,
         Mats = nsamples(ps),
         ASVs = sum(taxa_sums(ps) > 0),
         Reads = sum(sample_sums(ps)),
         `Mean reads per mat` = round(mean(sample_sums(ps))),
         `Min reads per mat`  = min(sample_sums(ps)))
}
```

#--------------------------

# 1. Data

```{r data}
reefs_all <- readRDS(input_file)
reefs_all <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(reefs_all) > 0, reefs_all)   # ASVs only found in other samples
steps <- data_summary(reefs_all, "Reef mats after decontamination")
```

# 2. Mats with few reads

```{r low reads}
reads_mat <- tibble(sample_id = sample_names(reefs_all),
                    site      = as(sample_data(reefs_all), "data.frame")$site,
                    Reads     = sample_sums(reefs_all)) %>%
  mutate(Removed = Reads < min_reads)

low_mats <- reads_mat %>% filter(Removed)
low_mats   # mats removed

reefs <- prune_samples(!sample_names(reefs_all) %in% low_mats$sample_id, reefs_all)
reefs <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(reefs) > 0, reefs)
steps <- bind_rows(steps, data_summary(reefs, paste0("Mats < ", format(min_reads, big.mark = ","), " reads removed")))
```

Figure S1: reads per mat before (A, removed mats in red) and after (B) removing mats with fewer than `r format(min_reads, big.mark = ",")` reads.

```{r reads plot}
p_reads_all <- ggplot(reads_mat, aes(x = reorder(sample_id, Reads), y = Reads, colour = Removed)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = min_reads, linetype = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "black", `TRUE` = "#E64B35"),
                      labels = c(`FALSE` = "Kept", `TRUE` = "Removed"), name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(x = "Mats (ordered by number of reads)", y = "Reads", title = "A. Reads per mat") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom")

p_reads_kept <- ggplot(filter(reads_mat, !Removed), aes(x = Reads)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 15, fill = "grey60", colour = "white") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(x = "Reads per mat", y = "Number of mats", title = "B. Mats retained") +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

p_reads <- p_reads_all / p_reads_kept
p_reads
save_fig(p_reads, "F1_reads_per_mat", width = 9, height = 9)
```

# 3. Rare ASVs

ASVs present (≥ `min_count` read) in fewer than `r 100 * prev_threshold`% of the mats are removed. This also removes ASVs found in a single mat.

```{r prevalence filter}
asv_mat <- as(otu_table(reefs), "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(reefs)) asv_mat <- t(asv_mat)

prevalence <- rowMeans(asv_mat >= min_count)
reefs_filtered <- prune_taxa(prevalence >= prev_threshold, reefs)
message("ASVs kept: present in at least ", ceiling(prev_threshold * nsamples(reefs)), " of ", nsamples(reefs), " mats")

steps <- bind_rows(steps, data_summary(reefs_filtered,
                   paste0("ASVs in < ", 100 * prev_threshold, "% of mats removed")))
steps   # numbers for Results 3.1
save_tab(steps, "T1_reads_and_asvs")

saveRDS(reefs_filtered, counts_file)
```

# 4. Taxonomy

Number of different names per rank in the filtered data; "assigned" leaves out names such as uncultured or unknown.

```{r taxonomy summary}
tax_df <- as.data.frame(as(tax_table(reefs_filtered), "matrix"))

tax_summary <- tibble(Rank = tax_ranks[-1]) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(`Names (all)`      = n_distinct(na.omit(tax_df[[Rank]])),
         `Names (assigned)` = n_distinct(tax_df[[Rank]][!is_unassigned(tax_df[[Rank]])]),
         `ASVs assigned (%)` = round(100 * mean(!is_unassigned(tax_df[[Rank]])), 1)) %>%
  ungroup()
tax_summary
save_tab(tax_summary, "T2_taxonomy_summary")
```

# 5. TSS normalisation

Total Sum Scaling: reads of each ASV divided by the total reads of the mat (<https://www.nature.com/articles/s41522-020-00160-w>).

```{r tss}
reefs_tss <- transform_sample_counts(reefs_filtered, function(x) x / sum(x))
stopifnot(all(abs(sample_sums(reefs_tss) - 1) < 1e-8))
saveRDS(reefs_tss, tss_file)
```

# 6. Stacked table

One row per ASV and mat, with the taxonomy and the metadata (used for the barplots and heatmap in script 4).

```{r stacked table}
env <- as(sample_data(reefs_tss), "data.frame") %>% filter(!is.na(site))

tss_mat <- as(otu_table(reefs_tss), "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(reefs_tss)) tss_mat <- t(tss_mat)

taxa_info_all <- data.frame(tss_mat, as(tax_table(reefs_tss), "matrix"), check.names = FALSE)
taxa_info_all$OTU <- rownames(taxa_info_all)

taxa_stacked <- taxa_info_all %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(sample_names(reefs_tss)),
               names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "relative_abundance") %>%
  left_join(env, by = "sample_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(site)) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Every mat must have every ASV
stopifnot(all(table(taxa_stacked$sample_id) == ntaxa(reefs_tss)))

write.csv(taxa_info_all, tss_table_file)
write.csv(taxa_stacked, stacked_file)
beep(2)
```
